I replied to Marcus in his DM: he should keep Tuesday 10 Nov at 10:15 free.

That comes from his own DM with me on 14 Oct. He said then that his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Driftwood rollout would be on Tuesdays at 10:15 from then on. The call isn't on his calendar, and there's nothing about it in the North team channels he's in.

I told him I couldn't confirm the time hasn't changed since then, and offered to add it as a recurring event. I haven't changed his calendar.
